```{r}
utci_daily <- triggerR$read_utci_daily()
utci_hourly <- triggerR$read_hourly()
trigger_hourly <- triggerR$read_hourly()
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 13
#| fig-height: 8

stress_bands <- tibble(
  stress = c("Extreme cold", "Very strong cold", "Strong cold", "Moderate cold", "Slight cold",
             "No thermal stress", "Moderate heat", "Strong heat", "Very strong heat", "Extreme heat"),
  ymin = c(-Inf, -40, -27, -13, 0, 9, 26, 32, 38, 46),
  ymax = c(-40, -27, -13, 0, 9, 26, 32, 38, 46, Inf)
) %>%
  mutate(xmin = min(utci_daily$date), xmax = max(utci_daily$date))

stress_colors <- c(
  "Extreme cold" = "#1E3A8A", "Very strong cold" = "#2563EB",
  "Strong cold" = "#60A5FA", "Moderate cold" = "#93C5FD",
  "Slight cold" = "#DBEAFE", "No thermal stress" = "#D1D5DB",
  "Moderate heat" = "#FDBA74", "Strong heat" = "#FB923C",
  "Very strong heat" = "#EA580C", "Extreme heat" = "#B91C1C"
)

ggplot(utci_daily, aes(x = date)) +
  geom_rect(data = stress_bands, aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = stress),
          inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = utci_min, ymax = utci_max), fill = "#A6CEE3", alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(aes(y = utci_mean), color = "#1F78B4", linewidth = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ city, ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = stress_colors, name = "Thermal stress") +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "3 months", date_labels = "%b %Y") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(-27, -13, 0, 9, 26, 32, 38, 46)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-30, 48)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "UTCI (°C)", title = "Daily UTCI trends across study cities",
       subtitle = "Daily mean (line), minimum–maximum range (shaded area) and thermal stress classes (background)") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE, override.aes = list(alpha = 0.7))) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom", legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-utci-stress-distribution
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 8

utci_stress <- triggerR$read_utci_hourly() %>%
  mutate(stress = cut(utci, breaks = c(-Inf, -40, -27, -13, 0, 9, 26, 32, 38, 46, Inf),
                      labels = stress_bands$stress, right = FALSE))

stress_counts <- utci_stress %>%
  count(city, stress, .drop = FALSE) %>%
  group_by(city) %>%
  mutate(percentage = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(stress_counts, aes(x = stress, y = n, fill = stress)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ city, ncol = 2) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = stress_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of hours", title = "Thermal stress distribution across study cities") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
```
